name: ACN Song 2030
description: Accenture Song 2030 template (Sept 2026) — Graphik, 21 layouts in matched White/Dark pairs: covers (white, dark, photo), 'id'-style numbered section dividers, bold statements, quotes, 2x3 and 7-up photo grids, 12-column grids. Wordmark 'Accenture Song' + copyright in the footer are provided by the master. Content layout puts the headline at y=0.94 and a subheadline placeholder (idx 10) at y=1.60 that serves as the message line.

layout_constants.note: This template does NOT use the default helpers geometry. Override these module constants right after load_theme(): title sits at y=0.94, message line is placeholder idx 10 at y=1.60, content starts at y=2.10, content baseline (master guide) is y=6.51, footer furniture starts at y=7.21.

cover.note: Layout 2: 'Cover White'. White background — use BLACK text. idx=0 title @0.67in (4.25in tall, 160pt default: keep titles to 2-4 words per line or set 72-96pt for longer titles), idx=10 date @5.58in (10pt, 'Month YYYY'), idx=11 subtitle/client @5.58in x=3.47 (10pt). Dark variant = layout 12 (WHITE text), photo variant = layout 13 (picture idx=12 full-bleed + WHITE text).

idx_0.note: presentation title — BLACK, Graphik, very large

cover_dark.note: Layout 12: 'Cover Dark'. Same placeholder structure as layout 2, WHITE text. Layout 13 'Cover Photo' adds picture idx=12 (13.33x7.5in) behind the same placeholders.

content.note: Layout 0: 'Headline + Content'. Title idx=0 @0.94in (11.50in wide, 0.57in tall, 40pt master default — set 28pt). Subheadline idx=10 @1.60in (6.77in wide, 0.26in tall) is the MESSAGE LINE: write to it, 16-18pt, do NOT call clear_placeholders() on idx 10 without first writing the message. No breadcrumb placeholder: add_breadcrumb creates a textbox — place it at y=0.14 (eyebrow guide), left of the top-right page number. No body placeholder: clean canvas from y=2.10 to y=6.51. Master provides 'Accenture Song' wordmark @7.21in and copyright @7.26in; do not call set_footer() text overrides that collide with them. Dark twin = layout 10 (WHITE text).

section.note: Layout 3: 'Section Divider White'. Left half: giant section number idx=10 (588pt, clipped 'id'-style, use 2 digits '01'). Right half: idx=0 section title @0.80in x=6.71 (80pt default — set 36-44pt for titles longer than 2 words), idx=11 one-sentence context @5.58in. Vertical divider line at x=6.67 is part of the layout. Dark twin = layout 14, photo twin = layout 15 (picture idx=12). Do NOT draw a background rectangle: use the dark layout instead.

idx_0.note: section name — BLACK (white layout) / WHITE (dark layout)

idx_10.note: two-digit section number, oversized and clipped by design

bold_statement.note: Layout 4 / 16: 'Bold Statement'. idx=0 statement (100pt default, 12.9in wide — set 44-60pt for a full sentence), idx=13 faint stacked numbers @0.14in in #DADADA. Use for Pattern D (Key Message) instead of drawing a purple rectangle.

quote.note: Layout 7 / 18: 'Quote Single'. idx=0 quote (80pt default — set 36-44pt), idx=10 portrait picture @x=10.99 y=3.33 (2.21x2.90in), idx=11 attribution name, idx=14 attribution role (10pt).

grid_showcase_2x3.note: Layout 6 / 17: 'Grid Showcase 2x3'. idx=0 title top-left (5.14in wide), pictures idx=21 (top-right 3.33x3.74) and idx=30 (bottom-left 6.67x3.75), three text cells: number idx=26/35/33 + caption idx=25/34/32 (2.88x0.54in each).

product_grid_7up.note: Layout 8 / 19: 'Product Grid 7 Up'. Title idx=0 top-left cell; six picture placeholders (3.33x1.86in) idx=16,18,21,27,30,31,36 with number/caption pairs idx=17/10, 26/25, 23/22, 29/28, 35/34, 33/32, 38/37.

closing.note: No salutation layout in this template. make_closing_slide() should use layout 12 'Cover Dark' (or 2 'Cover White') with the title placeholder set to the closing text, or the blank dark layout 11 with a textbox.
